damage_definitions.tasseling: lower leaves from ground to 60 cm when half of plot plants have open tassels; 50% is phenological incidence, not leaf-loss fraction
damage_definitions.silking: lower leaves below cob leaf when half of plot plants have open silks; not 50% leaf removal

pooled_mean_column_excluded: Not an additional independent region or replicate
